sources.what: What Wikidata and Wikipedia say of each country of the game and of its flag. items, by the id of the country: its Wikidata entity (wd); what it is called in full (official, P1448), what it calls itself (native, P1705) and its motto (motto, P1451), each a list of [language, text]; its anthem (anthem, P85), how it is governed (government, P122) and its flag (flag, P163), each a list of entities; the file of its coat of arms in Commons (arms, P94); and its page in each Wikipedia (pages). Only statements of best rank that have not ended are told. flags, by the entity of the flag: the day it began with how exactly it is known (since, P571: [day, precision], 11 a day, 10 a month, 9 a year), its proportions as width to height (ratio, P2061), its colours (colours, P462) and who designed it (by, P287), each a list of entities, and its page in each Wikipedia (pages). names: the name in Spanish and in English of every entity named. boxes, by language:title: the box of facts that the page opens with, as it is written.
sources.es: Lo que Wikidata y Wikipedia dicen de cada país y de su bandera
sources.note: nombre oficial de 241 de 251 países, lema de 187, himno de 234, bandera de 243; 235 banderas con fecha; 973 fichas de Wikipedia
